findings.evidence: Line 206 RHS `toLp (μ⁻¹ • rightTranslate (convolutionCLM k f) g)`; the eigenspace hypotheses only serve to identify `f` with `toLp (μ⁻¹ • convolutionCLM k f)` (Convolution.lean:535), and play no role in how translation interacts with `toLp`. The general form is the reusable statement for any continuous function, e.g. for uniform-approximation arguments over C(G, 𝕜).

findings.issue: `rightRegularLp_eq_toLp_smul_rightTranslate` is the only public lemma relating `rightRegularLp` to continuous functions, yet it carries `k`, `hμ : μ ≠ 0` and `hf : f ∈ eigenspace`. The content is kernel- and eigenvalue-free: for every `F : C(G, 𝕜)`, `rightRegularLp 𝕜 G g (toLp F) = toLp (rightTranslate F g)`.
